title: Autopilot
description: The platform re-runs the analysis on a schedule, compares against recorded history and your targets, and pushes a briefing when something matters — instead of waiting to be opened.
dayOfMonthHint: Capped at 28 so a schedule never silently skips February.
cronHint: Standard five-field cron, e.g. 0 7 * * 1-5 for weekdays at 07:00.
cooldownHint: A standing problem is still true tomorrow. The cooldown stops it being reported every morning until you stop reading the channel.
targetsHint: The one thing the platform cannot infer. 'Revenue below 50,000 is a problem' is a fact about your rent, not about your data.
noChannelsYet: No channels yet — alerts will appear in the in-app inbox.
quietHoursHint: Alerts are still found and stored during quiet hours — only the push is held back.
sendWhenQuiet: Send even when nothing is found
sendWhenQuietHint: Off by default: a notification that says 'nothing happened' trains people to ignore the channel.
previewRunning: Running the same analysis, without sending anything…
previewNote: Nothing was sent and nothing was recorded — this is the real pipeline, with delivery and history switched off.
secretsNote: Credentials are encrypted at rest and never sent back to the browser.
noChannelsHint: Alerts already appear in the in-app inbox. Add email, Telegram or WhatsApp to have them reach you where you actually read things.
noAlertsHint: Alerts from scheduled runs appear here, newest first, ranked by money at stake.
explainsFromRows: explains {share}% of the change from {rows}% of the transaction lines
noSchedulesHint: Create one and the platform starts checking this project on its own — nightly, weekly, or on your own cron.
noRunsHint: Every run is recorded here, including the ones that found nothing — 'no alerts' and 'not running since Tuesday' look identical otherwise.
suppressedInRun: {n} further finding(s) were held by the cooldown.
verifyHint: A new channel is untested. Send it a test message from the Channels tab before a briefing depends on it.
whereHint: Pick where this report is delivered. Without a channel it only reaches the in-app inbox.
